description: Tool to list GA4 properties based on filter criteria. Use when you need to find properties under a specific parent account or with specific firebase projects. Supports pagination and including soft-deleted properties.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing GA4 properties.

filter.description: Required. Expression for filtering the results. Fields eligible for filtering: `parent:` (resource name of parent account/property), `ancestor:` (resource name of parent account), or `firebase_project:` (id or number of linked firebase project). Examples: 'parent:accounts/123' (account with id 123), 'parent:properties/123' (property with id 123), 'ancestor:accounts/123' (account with id 123), 'firebase_project:project-id' (firebase project with id project-id), 'firebase_project:123' (firebase project with number 123).
filter.title: Filter

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of properties to return (1-200). Default is 50.
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. Token from previous ListProperties call to retrieve the next page.
pageToken.title: Page Token

showDeleted.description: Optional. Whether to include soft-deleted (trashed) properties. Default is false.
showDeleted.title: Show Deleted

inputSchema.title: ListPropertiesFilteredRequest

name: list_properties_filtered

ListPropertiesFilteredResponse.description: Response model for listing GA4 properties.

nextPageToken.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results, if any.
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token

properties.description: List of Property resources matching the filter criteria.
properties.title: Properties

ListPropertiesFilteredResponse.title: ListPropertiesFilteredResponse

account.title: Account

currencyCode.title: Currency Code

deleteTime.title: Delete Time

displayName.title: Display Name

name.title: Name
